paradigms.name: Swiss International Style
paradigms.essence: Objective, grid-led typography where alignment, scale contrast and white space carry meaning.
traits: neo-grotesk type at extreme size contrast
css_moves: grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr) with text hung on column 1 and 5
small captions in the same family, never a second typeface
risks: sterile if the type scale is timid

paradigms.name: Bauhaus
paradigms.essence: Primary colors and primary shapes as building blocks; form follows function, played with joy.
traits: circle, square, triangle as layout elements
css_moves: writing-mode: vertical-rl for a rotated label
grid areas filled with flat primary color blocks
text-transform: lowercase for headings (Bayer's universal alphabet spirit)
risks: kitsch if all three primaries appear everywhere

paradigms.name: Constructivism
paradigms.essence: Dynamic diagonals, red-and-black propaganda energy, photomontage and type as architecture.
traits: arrows and bars as vectors of force
css_moves: transform: rotate(-12deg) on the headline block
huge condensed uppercase with tight leading
risks: hard to make accessible with rotated text (keep body horizontal)
references: El Lissitzky 'Beat the Whites with the Red Wedge'

paradigms.name: Art Deco
paradigms.essence: Machine-age glamour: symmetry, gold on black, stepped and fanned geometry, tall elegant capitals.
traits: gold/brass on black or deep jewel tones
css_moves: stepped frames with nested outlines (outline + outline-offset)
risks: gold text with low contrast — check accent-text

paradigms.name: Art Nouveau (web-adapted)
paradigms.essence: Flowing whiplash curves, botanical frames and hand-shaped lettering — nature as ornament.
traits: decorative display lettering with calm body serif
css_moves: SVG botanical border frames around sections
risks: fussy and slow if ornaments are heavy images

paradigms.name: Mid-century Modern
paradigms.essence: Optimistic, playful modernism: organic shapes, warm earthy colors, textured illustrations, jaunty layouts.
traits: mustard, teal, orange, olive on cream-free light grounds
css_moves: SVG organic shapes with grain texture behind images
risks: too many motif types at once

paradigms.name: Memphis
paradigms.essence: Irreverent pattern-clash: squiggles, terrazzo, confetti and clashing brights on black linework.
traits: squiggles, zigzags, confetti and terrazzo patterns
css_moves: SVG squiggle and zigzag patterns as backgrounds
hard offset shadows in a second color
references: Saved by the Bell era graphics

paradigms.name: Pop / Color-block
paradigms.essence: Huge flat color fields, cut-out subjects and loud type; posters you can scroll.
css_moves: sections alternate saturated grounds (color-mode palette + accents)
cutout PNG/SVG subjects overlapping section edges

paradigms.name: Web Brutalism (raw)
paradigms.essence: Honest, unpolished HTML: default-looking controls, visible structure, system fonts or mono, ugly-on-purpose.
traits: dense text, no images or raw images
css_moves: font-family: ui-monospace or a grotesk at one size
border: 1px solid black on everything structural
risks: reads as broken to mainstream users

paradigms.name: Neo-brutalism
paradigms.essence: Brutalism made friendly: thick black outlines, hard offset shadows, flat bright fills, chunky type.
risks: now common in AI output too — vary fills and avoid the yellow/pink default

paradigms.name: Editorial / Magazine
paradigms.essence: A magazine spread on screen: strong typographic hierarchy, generous images, pull quotes, captions, rhythm.
traits: display serif or contrasting display headlines
css_moves: grid with 6 columns, images spanning 4, text 3, captions in a margin
risks: slides into the broadsheet AI default if hairlines + newspaper columns dominate
references: The New York Times Magazine features

paradigms.name: Broadsheet / Newspaper
paradigms.essence: Dense columns, hairline rules, mastheads and datelines — the newspaper page.
css_moves: masthead in a blackletter or high-contrast serif
risks: THE most common Claude/AI 'tasteful' default — only when the brief asks for newspaper

paradigms.name: Japanese Minimalism (Ma)
paradigms.essence: Meaningful emptiness: asymmetric calm, natural materials, quiet type, one precise accent.
traits: a single seal-red or ink accent
css_moves: writing-mode: vertical-rl for a section label
max-width 34rem text floated far right or left
images with generous mat (padding) inside a frame
risks: empty rather than intentional if content is thin

paradigms.name: Scandinavian Soft Modern
paradigms.essence: Light, functional and human: soft neutrals, rounded geometric sans, honest photography, quiet confidence.
traits: muted accent from nature (berry, spruce, sea)
risks: bland — needs one distinctive move (motif, photography, or type)

paradigms.name: Organic / Biophilic
paradigms.essence: Shapes and colors from living systems: blobs, leaves, flowing dividers, earthy palettes, tactile grain.
traits: nature photography cut into organic masks
risks: busy if blobs + waves + leaves all appear

paradigms.name: Y2K / Chrome
paradigms.essence: Millennium optimism: chrome and liquid metal, iridescence, bubbly type, translucent plastic, tech-gloss.
traits: chrome/metallic gradients on objects and type
css_moves: linear-gradient metallic stops on text with background-clip: text (one headline only)
backdrop-filter blur panels with white inner highlight
risks: tacky if every surface is chrome

paradigms.name: Frutiger Aero
paradigms.essence: Glossy eco-tech optimism: sky blues and grass greens, water bubbles, glass, lens flares, clean humanist sans.
css_moves: buttons with top white gradient highlight (linear-gradient rgba(255,255,255,.7) to transparent 50%)
sky gradient backgrounds confined to a hero band

paradigms.name: Space Age / Retro-futurism
paradigms.essence: Optimistic NASA-era future: wide extended type, orbits, mission patches, technical labels, cosmic gradients.
traits: deep space or clean white with signal colors
css_moves: concentric ellipses in SVG behind hero
circular badge built from SVG textPath

paradigms.name: Terminal / CLI
paradigms.essence: The interface is text: monospace, prompts, ASCII structure, phosphor color, keyboard-first.
css_moves: font-family: mono at one size; hierarchy via color and brackets
animation: steps() caret blink (disable for reduced motion)
risks: near-black + acid-green is the cliché — prefer amber, ink-on-paper, or blue phosphor

paradigms.name: Synthwave / Neon
paradigms.essence: Night drive aesthetics: neon magenta/cyan on dark violet, grids to the horizon, chrome type, glow.
traits: neon glow on a few elements
css_moves: text-shadow neon glow on headline only
risks: purple glow everywhere is an AI tell — glow only signals

paradigms.name: Riso / Zine
paradigms.essence: Two or three spot inks, overprint, misregistration, grain and photocopied collage — handmade publishing.
css_moves: mix-blend-mode: multiply on stacked color layers
duplicate heading offset 3px in second ink
SVG feTurbulence grain + halftone mask on photos
risks: illegible if texture sits under body text

paradigms.name: Collage / Scrapbook
paradigms.essence: Personal, layered, tactile: cutouts, tape, notes, stickers and photos arranged by hand.
css_moves: tape via pseudo-elements with semi-transparent fill
risks: mobile layout of absolute layers — rebuild as a stack on small screens

paradigms.name: Kinetic Typography
paradigms.essence: Type is the image and it moves: marquees, variable-axis morphs, scroll-scrubbed headlines.
css_moves: @keyframes marquee translateX(-50%) with duplicated content; pause on hover; off for reduced motion

paradigms.name: Maximalism / Eclectic
paradigms.essence: More is more — curated: pattern on pattern, saturated jewel tones, mixed type, layered ornament, controlled by a grid.
traits: pattern clashing within a 2–3 hue family
css_moves: background layers: pattern SVG + gradient + image
three typographic voices with clear roles
framed image grid with varied aspect ratios
risks: chaos without a strict underlying grid

paradigms.name: Anti-design / Deconstructed
paradigms.essence: Breaking the rules on purpose: clashing scales, overlaps, odd alignments, rule-breaking that still guides the eye.

paradigms.name: Blueprint / Technical Drawing
paradigms.essence: Precision as aesthetic: grid paper, dimension lines, callouts, annotations, exploded views.
css_moves: SVG leader lines with markers pointing to product parts
risks: overused mono labels — only where they encode real measurements

paradigms.name: Data-dense / Terminal Pro
paradigms.essence: Information density as a feature: tight tables, tabular numerals, sparklines, keyboard-first, no decoration.
css_moves: color only for deltas (up/down) with icons for color-blind safety

paradigms.name: Bento Modular
paradigms.essence: A tiled canvas where each tile tells one fact through a real visual — Apple keynote slide on the web.
traits: each tile one idea with a visual
tile radius consistent with nested elements
risks: overused in 2024–26 AI output — tiles must show real product facets, not emoji + text

paradigms.name: Glassmorphism
paradigms.essence: Frosted glass layers over colorful depth; use only when there is something worth seeing through the glass.
css_moves: provide solid fallback for no backdrop-filter
risks: the purple-blue glow-blob + glass card is a top AI tell

paradigms.name: Claymorphism / Soft 3D
paradigms.essence: Toy-like soft 3D: inflated shapes, pastel-saturated colors, inner shadows, playful renders.
css_moves: box-shadow: inset -8px -8px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / .12), inset 8px 8px 16px rgb(255 255 255 / .6), 0 16px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / .12)

paradigms.name: Tactile / Neo-skeuomorphic
paradigms.essence: Objects you want to touch: realistic materials, knobs and switches, light and shadow with physics.
risks: heavy CSS; keep it to hero objects

paradigms.name: Dark Luxury
paradigms.essence: Cinematic restraint: deep grounds, high-contrast serif, slow reveals, precious single accent, big imagery.
traits: wide tracking small caps used sparingly
css_moves: image reveals via clip-path inset animation
accent used for 1 detail per view
risks: near-black + gold is common — vary with jewel-dark grounds

paradigms.name: White Cube / Gallery
paradigms.essence: The work is the hero: white space, tiny captions, precise grid, zero decoration, perfect image cropping.
css_moves: max image size with aspect-ratio preserved; object-fit: contain

paradigms.name: 70s Groovy
paradigms.essence: Warm, wavy and swashy: rainbow stripes, rounded fat type, sunset palettes, playful flow.
css_moves: repeating stripe bands with border-radius curves

paradigms.name: Grunge / 90s
paradigms.essence: Distressed, photocopied, layered and loud — xerox texture, torn type, energy over polish.

paradigms.name: Pixel / 8-bit
paradigms.essence: Low-res joy: pixel fonts for display, chunky sprites, limited palettes, game-UI framing.
traits: pixel display font (body stays readable sans/mono)

paradigms.name: Hand-drawn / Sketch
paradigms.essence: Human warmth: sketchy lines, doodle icons, wobbly frames, notebook paper — imperfection as honesty.
css_moves: SVG rough borders (generated or roughjs-like paths)
underline scribble SVG under one phrase per page max

paradigms.name: Monochrome Photographic
paradigms.essence: Black-and-white imagery, stark type and nothing else — the gravity of documentary.
traits: white or black type set on calm areas
css_moves: text over images only with a gradient scrim on calm zones

paradigms.name: Wabi-sabi
paradigms.essence: Beauty in imperfection and impermanence: rough textures, earthy muted tones, asymmetric quiet.

paradigms.name: Solarpunk
paradigms.essence: Hopeful ecological futurism: lush greens and sun yellows, Art-Nouveau-meets-tech curves, community and craft.
risks: greenwashing vibes if claims aren't real

paradigms.name: Utilitarian Product
paradigms.essence: Calm, fast, keyboard-first product UI: neutral surfaces, one accent, crisp type, strong states, zero ornament.
css_moves: 1px border + tonal surfaces, no big shadows
risks: indistinguishable from every AI SaaS page — differentiate via type pair, accent hue, and one signature interaction
